title: Notification Server
description: Go microservice for notifications: Redpanda as the event queue, MongoDB for storage, REST API for fetching notifications and marking them as read. Uses Redis for caching and pub/sub. Work in progress — learning custom log (Zap) and OpenTelemetry wrappers, consumer groups, and health probes.

title: Training Neural Networks to play Snake from Scratch in C++
description: Implemented a simple feedforward neural network in C++ to play the Snake game. The network takes the game state as input and outputs the next move. Trained using a genetic algorithm, where multiple instances of the game run in parallel, and the best-performing networks are selected for reproduction. The project demonstrates how to build and train a neural network from scratch without relying on external libraries.

title: Swarm in Blocks
description: High-level block-based interface for controlling drone swarms (Team Atena, SEMEAR/USP). CopterHack 2022 & 2023: Swarm Station (3D web visualizer, real-time drone state), collision avoidance, ROS/Clover integration. Programming via blocks or Python; planning, simulation, and navigation modes.

title: Resilient Distributed Systems Patterns
description: Explored and implemented patterns for building resilient distributed systems, focusing on fault tolerance, scalability, and maintainability.
